reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: I understand with a free version of an app that you have ads. However to even get into the app you have to deal with the pop up wanting to purchase a subscription. Then you get an ad that more than half the time you can’t get out of unless you close the app and reopen it.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
This doesn’t work as a good app because after only 2 seconds of opening it to check birthdays very loud music and annoying apps
appear that you can’t silence or turn off. it’s just the worst app i’ve ever had ….. was so
good before it was inundated with awful adverts

reviews.title: Basic functionality shouldn’t be paid
reviews.text: There’s no reason for me to use this app if don’t pay 45 dollars. Bad strategy.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: Used to be great but now it’s so hard to just see the birthday list. Way too many ads and so long .

reviews.title: Ads and more ads
reviews.text: Too many ads with the free version.

reviews.title: Used to love, but now it reminds me to “Stay Connected” to people that are not in my birthday list
reviews.text: The recently added “Stay Connected” feature is super annoying. It pulls from people in my address book, NOT people in my birthday list. I really don’t want to Be reminded to Stay connected with my friend’s ex-boyfriend or that person with whom I no longer speak. And there isn’t a way to disable this feature.

reviews.title: Angry
reviews.text:
I rarely bother to leave reviews but am so angry that I am reviewing this app. When I first had this app, I was happy using it with the few ads it had. I can accept that as I was using the free version. However now that they increased the number of ads and have made it almost impossible to close the ad even after it has played through, it is impossible to use at all. Within milliseconds an ad appears (before you get a chance to check any date) and you then have to wait ages, wade your way through to find how to get rid of it without being taken to the store to buy the advertised product before you can actually get to the birthday info on the app. 

I am going to delete this app and recommend anyone looking at this without wanting to pay the expensive in app purchases - DON’T BOTHER.

1 star is 1 star too many.

reviews.title: basically nothing without paying
reviews.text: it lt me pick some b days from contacts which was nice, but then wouldn’t let me add any more because i reached my free limit ( i was at about 5 or 4 contacts) then it was making me pay a subscription to add any more which was about $20 a month.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Only lets you add 5 birthdays before wanting to charge you. Not a good deal in my opinion. No lifetime price either. I’m not looking for more subscriptions.

reviews.title: Money Grab
reviews.text: This app sucks…all they want is your money and they bombard you with useless ads.

reviews.title: Declining quality
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for several years and it keeps getting worse. Mandatory ads that are sometimes impossible to close will pop up before you can access any information. Trying to scroll through your birthday listings can mean having to watch an ad. The intrusion of ads has ruined this app. Now looking for replacement for this app.

reviews.title: An app that was once great, is now full of ads the moment you open it.
reviews.text: Dear hip developers, you NEED to tone down the ads, the moment I open up the app EVERYTIME is a 30 second ad and even when you finish it, I move a little bit throughout the app and BOOM, ANOTHER AD. I’m about to move everything I built in this app to another app. Either change or I’m leaving. A 5 out of 5 star app is now a 1 out of 5 star app. Change how aggressive ads are or bye bye.

reviews.title: They limited the app
reviews.text: I was really looking forward to enjoying this app but the free version is limited to 5 birthdays which is ridiculous. Then it’s hidden behind a subscription.

reviews.title: So I have to pay now???
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over 4 years with NO PROBLEM! All of a sudden I start experiencing the app force closing whenever I try and open it. I HAD to deleted it and re downloaded just to find that all my data is gone, but there’s also a limit of up 5 birthdays that I can add on my account and if I want more I have to pay a subscription! 😡 This is very upsetting, this was my favorite app to use and I even recommended it to so many people because it was free to use … So disappointing

reviews.title: It’s dumb
reviews.text: Only lets you add like 3 birthdays. It’s not free. You have to pay to keep adding. It’s so dumb.

reviews.title: Was good
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years. Now info/dates are disappearing and others have duplicates. Also so many commercials you can’t even open app.
